# `codes.grow.packages:zipkin` — agent quickstart (Java 17+)

Ships inside the jar at `META-INF/grow/zipkin/AGENTS.md`
(`unzip -p zipkin-X.Y.Z.jar META-INF/grow/zipkin/AGENTS.md`). Docs:
https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/zipkin/ · Service: Zipkin · Categories: tracing ·
Package `codes.grow.packages.zipkin`.

## Client

```java
try (ZipkinClient client = ZipkinClient.fromEnv()) { // GROW_ZIPKIN_* > vendor env > defaults
  client.health();
}
```

Errors: `ZipkinException` subclasses (`ConfigException`, `NotFoundException`, …) with `code()`.

## Tracing

The tracing entry point (`initTracing` / `InitTracing` / `init_tracing`) and its options are documented in the
package README and https://grow-codes-packages.github.io/zipkin/tracing/ (span helpers `withSpan`, `traced`,
`currentTraceId`, HTTP middleware).
